newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips earnings more than double.
newsitem.headline: Philips earnings more than double.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said Thursday its profit from ongoing operations more than doubled in the second quarter to 693 million guilders ($337.4 million), helped by sound earnings across virtually all its product sectors.
In the 1996 quarter it earned 304 million guilders ($148 million).
The results roundly outstripped analysts' forecasts, which had ranged from 429 million to 540 million guilders ($209 million to $263 million).
Philips said net profit in the second quarter jumped to 747 million guilders ($363.6 million), up from a loss of 456 million ($222 million) in the same period last year.
Analysts expressed surprise at the extent of the jump in profits and most said they would readjust their earnings estimates for this year and 1998.
"The results are much better than expected and what is surprising is the enormous improvement in Europe. The loss in the United States was to be expected," said Steven Vrolijk of ING Barings.
"Better than expected, the only slightly disappointing segment was consumer products -- that's probably because of the start-up costs of mobile telephones etc.," said Rene Verhoef of NIB Securities.
